title: done's refusal names the source observation that voided the newest evaluation
outcome: done's refusal names the source observation that voided the newest evaluation
acceptance: When done is refused because the newest evaluation reads stale for a source move that a source observation after its cut decided, the refusal names that observation (run-feed position, workspace, revision, reporting session and time as recorded, beside the evaluated revision) on CLI text, CLI JSON and MCP, with the refusal's existing words and code unchanged; a refusal for another cause names none; tests cover both.

completion.summary: done's stale-evaluation refusal names the source observation that decided the move, beside the unchanged cause (a sibling StaleRecoveryContext through the preflight, the transactional recovery and the raw error; layout agreed with Engram::Coder for his later source context). Text: the reminder appends '. <sentence>'. JSON (CLI and MCP): recovery.deciding_observation, bounded as show bounds it. Raw error details: deciding_observation, whole. Other causes and reasons name none. The CLI JSON lock-phrase guard covers every receipt and this stderr error, and the budget measures the written form. Landed 7203a02b after three rounds (round 1 gate failed on the file-size guard; round 2 had Lows, fixed), full gate test-c70b05c4 9/9, independent evaluation passed.
